results.title: Obsidian: A versatile writing app tailored to your thinking
results.content: Reviewers see Obsidian as a fast, flexible markdown workspace. Main drawbacks are steep setup curve, plugin overload, weak search, weaker mobile experience.

results.title: Obsidian Reviews (2026)
results.content: Reviewers broadly see Obsidian as a fast, local-first Markdown notes tool that becomes a powerful personal knowledge base.

results.title: AFFiNE Reviews (2026)
results.content: Obsidian is great, and it has so many useful plugins but I can't selfhost it.

results.title: Obsidian Reviews (2026) | Product Hunt
results.content: The graph view and visual thinking side of Obsidian also had a real effect on me. It has a learning curve.

results.title: Ideaverse for Obsidian
results.content: Ideaverse for Obsidian is a strong starting point for learning and shaping a personal knowledge system in Obsidian.
